### McGraw Hill K-12 Math Programs Approved by Florida Department of Education Through State Adoption Process


September 3, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-K-12-Math-Programs-Approved-by-Florida-Department-of-Education-Through-State-Adoption-Process-2026.pdf)


*Approvals span elementary, middle, and high school mathematics, expanding access to research-based, personalized learning solutions for Florida educators and students*


**Key Highlights:**


- Florida Department of Education approves McGraw Hill math instructional materials across elementary, middle, and high school mathematics courses.
- Approved materials include K-8 Florida Math core curriculum, Grades 6-7 Florida Math Accelerated, Algebra 1, Algebra 1 Honors, Geometry, Geometry Honors, Algebra 2, Algebra 2 Honors and Precalculus Honors.
- McGraw Hill Florida Math delivers research-based curriculum, personalized learning, and data-driven assessment and instructional support designed to improve student achievement and math confidence.


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54598098&newsitemid=20260903941681&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=1af5affcbcb538d93ba2cdc03f0743bd) (NYSE: MH), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that all of its K-12 math programs submitted have been approved by the Florida Department of Education through the state's instructional materials adoption process, making them available for all 67 school districts across Florida to select and implement with their approximately 3 million students. The approvals span elementary, middle, and high school mathematics courses and include core and advanced mathematics offerings.


McGraw Hill's K-12 math programs have been approved by the Florida Department of Education for use across the state.


The approved McGraw Hill programs include:


- Florida Math, Grades K-5
- Florida Math, Grades 6-8
- Florida Math Accelerated, Grades 6-7
- Algebra 1 & Algebra 1 Honors
- Geometry & Geometry Honors
- Algebra 2 & Algebra 2 Honors
- Pre-Calculus Honors


"We’re committed to helping Florida educators build their students’ mathematical understanding, confidence, and readiness for future success," said Katie McClarty, Chief Academic Officer of McGraw Hill’s School group. "We're proud that the Florida Department of Education has approved McGraw Hill's math programs, recognizing the quality, rigor, and effectiveness of instructional materials and are excited to support Florida educators and their long history of student achievement and education excellence."


McGraw Hill’s Florida Math programs provide schools with comprehensive, research-based solutions that support personalized learning, differentiated instruction, and meaningful student engagement. They are designed to help educators meet the needs of all learners through high-quality content, actionable data, and flexible instructional pathways that support remediation, acceleration, and grade-level success. The solutions provide instruction in both print and digital formats designed to help students develop conceptual understanding, mathematical reasoning, and confidence through engaging learning experiences and real-world applications.


Built on decades of educational research and learning science, McGraw Hill's Florida Math portfolio combines proven instructional approaches with innovative technology and data-driven assessment to help educators identify learning opportunities and provide targeted support. It is supplemented with tools and solutions such as[McGraw Hill Plus](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fprek-12%2Fresources%2Fmcgrawhill-plus.html%3Fsrsltid%3DAfmBOop0Y9PUvy3jGsw0C9c1N1uRVQdr9ULjWdC2K5RUboX5vWLGYacK&esheet=54598098&newsitemid=20260903941681&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill+Plus&index=2&md5=76c4cd332317480e7c1ee9dff3e0877c) and[ALEKS](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fprek-12%2Fprogram%2Fmicrosites%2FMKTSP-GAB02M0%3Fsrsltid%3DAfmBOoogO-MZiJ0PfHj6IOpCYozSiMX8cQhawa2D6cXY2DPwBCccNaqJ&esheet=54598098&newsitemid=20260903941681&lan=en-US&anchor=ALEKS&index=3&md5=faeb114dab4eab56e02c9e9ef1a61460) , which work alongside our core math curricula to help educators interpret student data, find relevant resources, and personalize practice.


For more information about McGraw Hill Florida Math, visit[https://www.mheducation.com/prek-12/states/florida/browse/math.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fprek-12%2Fstates%2Fflorida%2Fbrowse%2Fmath.html&esheet=54598098&newsitemid=20260903941681&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fprek-12%2Fstates%2Fflorida%2Fbrowse%2Fmath.html&index=4&md5=07e78ba7637cd2f60fcebbfb2c8d1fdf) .
